tooltip.no_key: Set a Trafiklab API key in the widget settings.

show_countdown.label: Show countdown
show_countdown.description: Show minutes until the next train in the bar (otherwise just the train icon).

api_key.label: Trafiklab API key
api_key.description: API key for a Trafiklab Realtime APIs (Timetables) project. Get one free at trafiklab.se.

origin_name.label: Origin stop name
origin_name.description: Name of the stop to show departures from, e.g. "Linkoping C".

destination_name.label: Destination stop name
destination_name.description: Name of the destination stop, e.g. "Kimstad". Shown for reference; set the origin to the stop you're actually leaving from.

poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to poll Trafiklab for updated departures.
